mapper.update: UPDATE ddc_publish_task SET status = #{publishingStatus}, attempt_count = CASE WHEN status = #{pendingStatus} THEN attempt_count ELSE coalesce(attempt_count, 0) + 1 END, dispatched_at = #{dispatchedAt}, completed_at = NULL, failure_stage = NULL, error_message = NULL, updated_at = #{dispatchedAt}, version = version + 1, update_user_id = #{actor}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND change_id = #{changeId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status IN #{status}
